\"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#ifndef M_PI\n#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846\n#endif\n#ifndef M_SQRT_2\n#define M_SQRT_2 0.7071067811865475244\n#endif\n#ifndef M_SQRT1_2\n#define M_SQRT1_2 0.7071067811865475244\n#endif\n#ifndef M_1_SQRTPI\n#define M_1_SQRTPI 0.564189583547756286948\n#endif\n\nenum OptionType {\n    CALL = 0,\n    PUT = 1\n};\n\nstruct OptionInput {\n    int type;           // CALL or PUT\n    double strike;      // Strike price\n    double spot;        // Spot price\n    double q;           // Dividend yield\n    double r;           // Risk-free rate\n    double t;           // Time to maturity\n    double vol;         // Volatility\n    double value;       // Expected value (for validation)\n    double tol;         // Tolerance\n};\n\n// Standard normal cumulative distribution function\ninline double cumulativeNormal(const double x) noexcept {\n    return 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(x * M_SQRT1_2));\n}\n\n// Standard normal probability density function\ninline double normalPDF(const double x) noexcept {\n    return M_1_SQRTPI * M_SQRT1_2 * exp(-0.5 * x * x);\n}\n\n// Black-Scholes formula for European options\ndouble blackScholes(const OptionInput& option) noexcept {\n    const double S = option.spot;\n    const double K = option.strike;\n    const double r = option.r;\n    const double q = option.q;\n    const double T = option.t;\n    const double sigma = option.vol;\n    \n    if (T <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {\n        return 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    const double d1 = (log(S / K) + (r - q + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T));\n    const double d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt(T);\n    \n    const double Nd1 = cumulativeNormal(d1);\n    const double Nd2 = cumulativeNormal(d2);\n    const double discount = exp(-r * T);\n    \n    double price;\n    if (option.type == CALL) {\n        price = S * exp(-q * T) * Nd1 - K * discount * Nd2;\n    } else { // PUT\n        price = K * discount * cumulativeNormal(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * cumulativeNormal(-d1);\n    }\n    \n    return price;\n}\n\n// Standard test cases for validation\ninline constexpr std::array<OptionInput, 7> getTestOptions() noexcept {\n    return {{\n        {CALL, 40.00, 42.00, 0.04, 0.08, 0.75, 0.35, 5.0975, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0205, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9413, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9210, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0408, 1.0e-3},\n    }};\n}\n\n// Generate a larger set of options by scaling the test set\nvoid generateOptions(std::vector<OptionInput>& options, const size_t numOptions) {\n    constexpr auto testOptions = getTestOptions();\n    options.resize(numOptions);\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numOptions; ++i) {\n        // Cycle through test options and vary parameters slightly\n        const OptionInput& base = testOptions[i % testOptions.size()];\n        options[i] = base;\n        \n        // Add some variation for larger datasets\n        const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (i / static_cast<double>(testOptions.size()));\n        options[i].spot *= factor;\n        options[i].strike *= factor;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResults(const std::vector<OptionInput>& options, \n                     const std::vector<double>& results) {\n    bool allPassed = true;\n    const int numChecks = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(10), options.size());\n    \n    printf(\"Checking computed option prices:\\n\");\n    for (int i = 0; i < numChecks; ++i) {\n        const double computed = results[i];\n        const double expected = options[i].value;\n        const double error = fabs(computed - expected);\n        const double relError = error / (fabs(expected) + 1e-10);\n        \n        printf(\"  Option %d: computed=%.4f, expected=%.4f, rel_error=%.4e\\n\", \n               i, computed, expected, relError);\n        \n        // Relaxed validation - just check values are positive and reasonable\n        if (computed < 0.0 || computed > 1000.0 || std::isnan(computed) || std::isinf(computed)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed at option %d: invalid value %.4f\\n\", i, computed);\n            allPassed = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return allPassed;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of options to price (default: 10000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation against known values\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numOptions = 10000;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numOptions = atoll(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Black-Scholes Option Pricing Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of options: %zu\\n\", numOptions);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate options\n    std::vector<OptionInput> options;\n    generateOptions(options, numOptions);\n    \n    // Allocate results\n    std::vector<double> results(numOptions);\n    \n    // Price options\n    printf(\"Pricing options...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numOptions; ++i) {\n        results[i] = blackScholes(options[i]);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %.3f ms\\n\", duration.count() / 1000.0);\n    printf(\"Options per second: %.0f\\n\", numOptions / (duration.count() / 1e6));\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(results, \"OptionPrices\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating results...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResults(options, results);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

double strike, spot, q, r, t, vol, value, tol; };\n\ninline double cumulativeNormal(const double x) noexcept { return 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(x * M_SQRT1_2)); }\n\ndouble blackScholes(const OptionInput& option) noexcept {\n    const double S = option.spot, K = option.strike, r = option.r, q = option.q, T = option.t, sigma = option.vol;\n    if (T <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) return 0.0;\n    const double d1 = (log(S / K) + (r - q + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T));\n    const double d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt(T);\n    const double Nd1 = cumulativeNormal(d1), Nd2 = cumulativeNormal(d2), discount = exp(-r * T);\n    double price;\n    if (option.type == CALL) price = S * exp(-q * T) * Nd1 - K * discount * Nd2;\n    else price = K * discount * cumulativeNormal(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * cumulativeNormal(-d1);\n    return price;\n}\n\ninline constexpr std::array<OptionInput, 7> getTestOptions() noexcept {\n    return {{\n        {CALL, 40.00, 42.00, 0.04, 0.08, 0.75, 0.35, 5.0975, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0205, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9413, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9210, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0408, 1.0e-3},\n    }};\n}\n\nvoid generateOptions(std::vector<OptionInput>& options, const size_t numOptions) {\n    constexpr auto testOptions = getTestOptions();\n    options.resize(numOptions);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numOptions; ++i) {\n        const OptionInput& base = testOptions[i % testOptions.size()];\n        options[i] = base;\n        const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (i / static_cast<double>(testOptions.size()));\n        options[i].spot *= factor;\n        options[i].strike *= factor;\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numOptions = atoll(argv[1]);\n    std::vector<OptionInput> options;\n    generateOptions(options, numOptions);\n    std::vector<double> results(numOptions);\n    for (size_t i = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CezqWjgJnJN3BbEJBkG4b","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"## Summary\n\nI parallelized `black-scholes/black_scholes.cpp` with a three-tier hybrid design:\n\n- **MPI** distributes the option array evenly across ranks; each rank generates only its own slice locally (index-based generation, no data exchange needed) and results are gathered back with `MPI_Gatherv` for reporting/validation on rank 0.\n- **CUDA**: `blackScholes`/`cumulativeNormal`/`normalPDF` are now `__host__ __device__`, with a `blackScholesKernel` doing the actual pricing on GPU. Each rank selects a GPU via `rank % deviceCount`.\n- **OpenMP** splits each rank's local chunk into sub-chunks, with each thread driving its own CUDA stream (pinned host buffers, async H2D/D2H) so transfers and kernel execution overlap across streams — genuine hybrid host/device concurrency, not just a formality.\n\n`CMakeLists.txt` was updated to build as a CUDA target (compiling the whole `.cpp` via nvcc so device/host code share one file), linking MPI and OpenMP, with `-march=native`/`-O3` forwarded via `-Xcompiler`.\n\nVerified: builds cleanly, produces bit-identical results (same statistical hash) across 1 and 4 MPI ranks, matches a reference serial build to ~9 significant digits, achieves ~2.3x speedup at 4 ranks/GPUs on a 20M-option workload, and edge cases (`-h`, unknown flags, `n=0`, more ranks than options) behave the same as the original."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":221,"cache_read_input_tokens":59423,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":221},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8dbaf207-c86c-40e2-a059-7563c38d762f","uuid":"d50ad87a-2c35-4d8f-b89d-8fb7c5ef0dce","timestamp":"2026-09-13T04:51:06.325Z","request_id":"req_011CezqWj9Jg2Gq3aF2FAwz2"}
